schedule_intent: Publish no more than four quality Pins per Europe/Istanbul calendar date, at variable minute slots between 12:00 and next-day 02:00 Turkey time; enforce 3h between real Pins, avoid duplicates. Three redesigned replacement drafts may publish only after the original URL's 48h cooldown. Do not delete original until replacement confirms real Pinterest ID and media.

image_spec.brand_colors: Rotating bright editorial palettes: coral/cream, mint/teal, cobalt/lemon, lilac/pink, peach/navy, pale-yellow/ink. No repeated dark violet gradients.
rules: For drafts, prefer the genuine captured page screenshot inside a distinct high-contrast editorial 1000x1500 composition.
Screenshot capture requires live HTTP 200 + a real readable h1; never create a fake screenshot.
Cover hooks must be 4–7 honest words; every Pin contains one immediately usable takeaway and a modest Socialora signature.

Before a scheduled Pin, check the verified publicly served generated asset at /pinterest/{id}.png and the matching visual-manifest.json; if absent or inaccessible, skip rather than use a generic illustration.
Never imply mock platform analytics, fabricated user results or functionality not confirmed on the website.
The official Pinterest API must return actual pin ID and media URL before marking queue status published.
Prioritize organic outbound website clicks without misleading clickbait: one clear creator problem + helpful instruction + exact matching free tool, naturally keyword-optimized title and description.
No two consecutive published Pins may reuse the same composition when alternative ready drafts are available; do not merely recolor an identical layout.

asset_pipeline.source: Authentic site screenshots captured with Playwright on GitHub Actions
asset_pipeline.notes: Assets are prebuilt and publicly served from /public/pinterest. Only validated assets with a matching source_url may be used. Do not use draft image_url:null as evidence an image was already published.
asset_pipeline.layout_system: Six genuinely different verified screenshot-based compositions: editorial_split, mobile_showcase, tutorial_steps, magazine_feature, browser_insight, gallery_feature
asset_pipeline.publish_checks: Only use an existing manifest asset with same ID, cover_hook, source URL, required renderer version and a varied composition. Reject broken link, illegible screenshot or repeat design from recent Pins.

pins.image_brief: A clean profile header mockup with a before/after rewriting example. No follower count.

pins.title: YouTube Channel Name Ideas: 3 Things to Check
pins.description: Before choosing a channel name, check whether it's easy to say, recognizable and suitable for future content. Generate options, then verify availability yourself.
pins.image_brief: A wordmark study showing three illustrative channel name concepts, marked not availability-checked.

pins.title: Instagram Engagement Rate: Look Beyond Likes
pins.description: Likes alone don't show the full picture. Compare interactions against the same audience size and timeframe to make your own posts easier to evaluate. Try Socialora's free Instagram Engagement Rate Calculator.

pins.description: Comparing videos? Use the same engagement definition and timeframe every time. A simple calculator helps you compare your own posts without relying on vague impressions.
pins.image_brief: Two original short-form video cards with clearly labeled illustrative counts and same calculation basis.

pins.title: YouTube Engagement Rate Explained Simply
pins.description: View counts and engagement tell different stories. Calculate a consistent engagement rate for your own videos, then compare similar formats and topics rather than unrelated channels.
pins.image_brief: A visual guide showing views, likes and comments as separate illustrative measures; no fake growth curve.

pins.title: Follower Goals: Turn a Big Number Into Weekly Steps
pins.description: A follower target is easier to plan when you break it into small increments. Use the calculator for a scenario, then adjust based on actual progress. It's a planning tool, not a growth promise.
pins.image_brief: A weekly planning calendar with illustrative milestones marked as examples, not a forecast.

pins.title: Instagram Sponsorship Rate: Why Estimates Vary
pins.description: A creator partnership rate isn't determined by follower count alone. Engagement, content scope, usage rights and audience fit matter. Treat calculator outputs as starting estimates, not promises.
pins.image_brief: A notepad with four scope factors and a small label 'Estimate only', no invented dollar claims.

pins.title: X Engagement Rate: Compare Posts With Context
pins.description: A big impression count doesn't automatically mean a post helped your audience. Track the same types of interactions across similar posts, then test what your readers actually value.
pins.image_brief: A calm two-column metric explainer with neutral placeholders and no claimed benchmark.

pins.title: WhatsApp Click-to-Chat Link: A Simple Setup

pins.title: Instagram Reel Hooks: Fix the First 2 Seconds
pins.description: Most short videos lose viewers before the second word. Start directly on a clear problem or visual contrast instead of a slow greeting. Use this free idea generator to test stronger opening hooks for your niche.

pins.title: Instagram Caption Hooks That Get People Reading

pins.title: Instagram Bio SEO: Turn Profile Visits Into Follows
pins.description: Visitors decide in two seconds whether your page is worth following. Keep your niche topic, weekly value, and link reason unmistakable in three short lines. Preview cleaner bio drafts free in your browser.

pins.title: UGC Creator Pricing: Include Usage Rights Separately
pins.description: Organic Reels and paid ad whitelisting carry very different value for brands. Compare your recent average views and engagement before quoting a flat rate. Check a fair baseline range with our free sponsorship calculator.

pins.title: Instagram Reach Drop Checklist Before Deleting Posts
pins.description: A slow week rarely means an account ban. Check your Account Status, inspect 3-second hold rate, and rotate relevant niche tags instead of copy-pasting blocks. Run a quick reach check with this free tool.

pins.title: Stuck at 200 Views on TikTok? 3 Quick Checks
pins.description: Before deleting a stalled short clip, inspect full-video completion rate and For You feed share. Keep your subtitle hook clear inside the center safe zone and test a faster opening cut. Try this free TikTok diagnostic.

pins.title: Instagram 4:5 Photo Size: Keep Typography Sharp
pins.description: Wrong aspect ratios trigger heavy compression that blurs carousel headlines. Use exact 1080 by 1350 dimensions for feed posts and 1080 by 1920 for Stories. Preview and crop cleanly in your browser.

pins.title: YouTube Revenue Calculator: Estimate Niche Ad CPM
pins.description: Ad rates shift widely across niches, countries, and video length. Compare realistic RPM scenarios instead of relying on viral revenue guesses. Use this free YouTube money calculator to plan your channel milestones.

pins.title: Instagram Profile Audit Checklist for Creators
pins.description: Turn profile visits into followers by auditing your Name keywords, bio clarity, and top three pinned posts. Enter public figures into our free independent scorecard for an illustrative check and next ideas.

pins.title: Threads Bio Fonts: Keep Headlines Scannable
pins.description: Use custom Unicode styling sparingly for one bio label or key phrase, never for full paragraphs. Keep body text plain so screen readers and search stay accurate. Preview readable styles in our free Threads font tool.

audience: Worldwide English-speaking creators, independent professionals and small teams; no single-country focus

design_standard.accessibility: Readable at phone width; strong typography, 4-7 word cover hook maximum, contrast checked
design_standard.composition: 1 bold useful visual demonstration + small Socialora brand signature; no giant logo or large generic marketing button
design_standard.variety: Rotate editorial typography, illustration, useful comparison, original mockup, 3-step diagram, calendar, data explainer, device preview. Use distinctive palette and layout for each topic; do not output identical purple template pins.
design_standard.creative_tests: Evaluate human clarity in 2 seconds: question, actual visual answer, genuine reason to click. If graphic or copy fails, skip rather than publish filler.
design_standard.language: Natural human English, informative rather than promotional; no guaranteed results, invented followers/comments, vague inspiration, heavy hashtags or keyword stuffing
design_standard.truth: Do not imply example UI, simulated numbers, tool capabilities or results are real; do not claim platform endorsement.
design_standard.link: Link directly to relevant existing free-tool page and preserve unique UTM; check website link resolves.
design_standard.posting: Before each Pin, verify previous 24h topic/board and actual Pinterest IDs. Avoid duplicate URLs in same day when possible. New account: prioritize fresh ideas over sheer volume.
